label: nothing
what: The record does not support that two or more people were secretly preparing something together that the mayor was not told about. It does contain reports of a possible bakery bridge/port alteration, but these are explicitly unconfirmed; the baker says he witnessed no alteration. The neighbour and secretary repeatedly say no meeting preparations are needed, and the observed gathering at 17:45–18:00 does not establish any preparation or its purpose.
